task_instance: Generate a single narration clip: text 'Welcome to the demo. Today we'll show how it works.' using OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts model, voice 'cedar', saved as demo.mp3 in output/speech/, via the OpenAI Python SDK as the skill's bundled CLI (scripts/text_to_speech.py) prescribes.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires a live call to the OpenAI Audio (TTS) API, which requires an OPENAI_API_KEY tied to a paid OpenAI account. No such key is present in this environment (env has no OPENAI_API_KEY) and acquiring one is out of scope per sandbox safety rules (no account-bound or paid services, no searching for credentials). Additionally, verified independently that outbound network access to api.openai.com is blocked by the environment's egress proxy (CONNECT to api.openai.com returned 403 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'), so even with a key, the live API call could not reach OpenAI's servers from this runtime. Both problems are fundamental blockers to the skill's actual purpose (producing real synthesized audio), not merely missing local tooling -- the Python `openai` SDK itself installs and imports fine.
tools_used: Bash (pip install openai, python3 openai SDK call, curl proxy status/test)
evidence: 1) Source dir /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources/openai__skills__speech/ contains only SKILL.md and LICENSE -- the bundled scripts/text_to_speech.py and references/*.md that the skill instructs to use are not actually present, so even the CLI wrapper had to be improvised. 2) `pip install openai` succeeded (openai==3.19.2). 3) Calling client.audio.speech.create(model='gpt-4o-mini-tts', voice='cedar', input=...) with no valid key raised `APIConnectionError: Connection error.` (not even reaching an auth-failure stage). 4) `env | grep -i openai` returned nothing -- no OPENAI_API_KEY set. 5) `curl -sS -m 10 https://api.openai.com/v1/models -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test'` returned `curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`, and `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` showed api.openai.com is not in the proxy's allowed/no-proxy list and recent relay failures show 403 policy denials for other external hosts, confirming general outbound restriction to non-allowlisted third-party APIs. No audio file was produced; the deliverable (a real synthesized speech clip) could not be generated or verified.
